title: Regulator expects lawyers to report serious misconduct by other lawyers
summary: The VLSB+C expects lawyers to tell it when they reasonably believe a Victorian lawyer is engaging in serious misconduct. Its statement sets out what to report and how.
what_changes: The regulator expects reports where a lawyer reasonably believes a Victorian lawyer is engaging in serious misconduct.
Covers conduct that calls a lawyer's fundamental integrity into question or could lead to a miscarriage of justice.
Also covers conduct that otherwise undermines the integrity of the justice system.
Reports go to seriousmisconduct@lsbc.vic.gov.au or, from 5 January 2026, by phone on (03) 9679 8092.
who_it_applies_to: Victorian lawyers who reasonably believe another Victorian lawyer is engaging in serious misconduct.

history.event: VLSB+C published a statement expecting lawyers to report serious misconduct by other Victorian lawyers.
